before_any_event fa2dd247d6f5.rules: {Events:[{ProjectID:1 Family:views Name:ev_old Action:rename To:landing CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev1 Action:rename To:signup CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:1 Family:product Name:ev3 Action:block To: CreatedAt:} {ProjectID:2 Family:views Name:pageview Action:block To: CreatedAt:}] Attributes:[{ProjectID:1 Key:colour Action:rename To:color CreatedAt:}]}
before_any_event fa2dd247d6f5.sql:
WITH acts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT actor_id, actor_kind, day
  FROM events
  WHERE project_id = 1 AND family IN ('views', 'product') AND actor_id <> ''
    AND actor_kind IN ('user', 'install')
    AND day < DATE '2026-09-10' AND day <= DATE '2026-05-10' + 45 
),
firsts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, MIN(day) AS cohort_day, MIN(day) FILTER (WHERE actor_kind = 'user') AS user_day
  FROM acts
  WHERE actor_kind IN ('user', 'install')
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
days AS (SELECT DISTINCT actor_id, day FROM acts)
SELECT f.actor_id, strftime(f.cohort_day, '%Y-%m-%d'), strftime(f.user_day, '%Y-%m-%d'),
  string_agg(CAST(d.day - f.cohort_day AS VARCHAR), ',' ORDER BY d.day)
FROM firsts f JOIN days d ON d.actor_id = f.actor_id AND d.day >= f.cohort_day AND d.day <= f.cohort_day + 45
WHERE f.cohort_day BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-10'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY f.actor_id
